changes.name: RoundedVisuals
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local function roundPart(p,r)
 local c=p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
 -- Physical Parts cannot use UICorner, so shape is handled with cylinders/balls and layered geometry.
end

local starter=world:FindFirstChild("StarterIsland")
local earth=world:FindFirstChild("IslandEarth")
if starter then
 starter.Transparency=1
 starter.CanCollide=false
end
if earth then
 earth.Transparency=1
 earth.CanCollide=false
end

local old=world:FindFirstChild("RoundedIsland")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="RoundedIsland";folder.Parent=world

local function disc(name,diameter,height,y,color,material)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=name
 p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 p.Size=Vector3.new(height,diameter,diameter)
 p.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)
 p.Position=Vector3.new(0,y,0)
 p.Anchored=true
 p.Color=color
 p.Material=material
 p.Parent=folder
 return p
end

disc("GrassTop",54,3,18.5,Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
disc("EarthUpper",50,4,15,Color3.fromRGB(105,76,50),Enum.Material.Ground)
disc("EarthLower",42,4,11.2,Color3.fromRGB(88,62,44),Enum.Material.Ground)
disc("IslandBottom",30,4,7.5,Color3.fromRGB(74,55,43),Enum.Material.Rock)

-- Make tree canopies softer and rocks less box-like.
for _,obj in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
  if obj.Name=="TreeCrown" or obj.Name=="ForestLeaves" then
   obj.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
  elseif obj.Name=="Rock" or obj.Name=="ForestRock" then
   obj.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
   obj.Size=Vector3.new(obj.Size.X,obj.Size.Y*.75,obj.Size.Z)
  elseif obj.Name=="TreeTrunk" or obj.Name=="ForestTrunk" then
   obj.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
   obj.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)
  end
 end
end

-- Rounded-looking core pedestal using cylinders.
local decor=world:FindFirstChild("IslandDecor")
if decor then
 local pedestal=decor:FindFirstChild("CorePedestal")
 if pedestal then
  pedestal.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
  pedestal.Size=Vector3.new(1.5,10,10)
  pedestal.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)
 end
end

print("Rounded island visual pass loaded")
